parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import json, re, uuid

raw = """$exec"""
alert = json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) else raw

data    = alert.get("data", {}) or {}
source  = alert.get("source", "unknown")
level   = int(alert.get("level", 0) or 0)
fulllog = alert.get("full_log", "") or ""

observables = []
def add(dtype, value):
    v = str(value).strip() if value else ""
    if v and {"dataType": dtype, "data": v} not in observables:
        observables.append({"dataType": dtype, "data": v})

if source == "suricata":
    add("ip", data.get("src_ip"))
    add("ip", data.get("dest_ip"))
    add("domain", (data.get("dns") or {}).get("rrname"))
    add("fqdn", (data.get("http") or {}).get("hostname"))
    add("url", (data.get("http") or {}).get("url"))
    add("hash", (data.get("fileinfo") or {}).get("sha256"))
elif source == "falco":
    of = data.get("output_fields", data)
    add("filename", of.get("fd.name"))
    add("other", of.get("proc.cmdline"))
elif source == "tetragon":
    pe = (data.get("process_exec", {}) or {}).get("process", {})
    add("filename", pe.get("binary"))

for ip in set(re.findall(r"\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b", fulllog)):
    add("ip", ip)
for h in set(re.findall(r"\b[a-fA-F0-9]{64}\b", fulllog)):
    add("hash", h)

if   level >= 15: sev = 4
elif level >= 12: sev = 3
elif level >= 7:  sev = 2
else:             sev = 1

ioc_list  = [o["data"] for o in observables] or ["n/a"]
ips       = [o["data"] for o in observables if o["dataType"] == "ip"]
dest_ip   = data.get("dest_ip") or (ips[0] if ips else "")
uniqueref = "wazuh-%s-%s" % (alert.get("wazuh_id", "x"), uuid.uuid4().hex[:8])

exit(json.dumps({
  "source": source,
  "level": level,
  "severity_base": sev,
  "observables": observables,
  "ioc_list": ioc_list,
  "ips": ips,
  "dest_ip": dest_ip,
  "uniqueref": uniqueref,
  "title": "[" + source + "] " + str(alert.get("description", "")),
  "agent": (alert.get("agent") or {}).get("name", "desconocido")
}))

raw = """$exec.level""".strip()
try:
    level = int(raw)
except Exception:
    level = 0
if   level >= 15: sev = 4
elif level >= 12: sev = 3
elif level >= 7:  sev = 2
else:             sev = 1
sourceref = "wazuh-%s-%s" % (level, uuid.uuid4().hex[:10])
exit(json.dumps({
  "severity_final": sev,
  "sourceref": sourceref
}))
